what_it_does: T-REX is a specialized chip for running Transformer AI models faster and more efficiently. The main problem is that loading data from external memory (the system RAM outside the chip) burns up most of the energy and wastes chip capacity—only 9% of the chip's hardware gets used productively. This paper redesigns the memory system to keep data local longer and reschedules operations to keep all the math units busy, cutting the energy cost per generated token from 0.41 to 3.95 microjules depending on the model size and input batch.
